verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://sandbox0.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with product-oriented content. A second probe confirms markdown versions of the docs are served (e.g. /docs/sandbox.md), and many doc pages are published as .md files that agents can ingest directly. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or of how complete the llms.txt index is beyond its header.
